The DEIM layout detector uses a backbone distilled from DINOv3.
Built using DINOv3. Copyright Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates.
DINOv3 license: https://github.com/facebookresearch/dinov3/blob/main/LICENSE.md

The pipeline's adapter adds digest-pinned model downloads, bounded CPU execution,
strict page-result validation, recognition confidence, folio retention and the
shared document text/coordinate/quality contracts. It does not redistribute the
model binaries; workers download the pinned upstream assets and verify SHA-256.
